title: E-QTM-0093: the toric code built from the {3,4,3,4} mesh complex (qubits on D4 edges, X-checks on cells, Z-checks on...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0093 in the quantum arena: the toric code built from the {3,4,3,4} mesh complex (qubits on D4 edges, X-checks on cells, Z-checks on root triangles) has exactly four logical qubits per connected component, four at side 3 and eight at side 4 where the even side splits the mesh in two, while an open patch has zero and every X-check commutes with every Z-check.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
